title: Wrong total when cart has a discounted item
body: We're on pydantic 2.7. When a cart contains an item with a 10% discount, the order total ignores the discount. `compute_total` adds list prices instead of discounted prices.

title: Urgent: move off the abandoned python-jose package
body: python-jose is unmaintained and flagged by our scanner. Replace it with PyJWT for token encoding and decoding; behaviour should stay the same.

title: FastAPI startup warning about on_event
body: Every test run prints `on_event is deprecated, use lifespan event handlers instead`. Please move our startup hook to a lifespan handler.

title: Allow admins to bulk-delete archived projects
body: Admins currently delete archived projects one at a time. Add a bulk delete endpoint that takes a list of project ids.

title: Changelog is missing the 2.1 release
body: CHANGELOG.md stops at 2.0.3 but we shipped 2.1.0 last week with the new export feature. Please add the 2.1.0 entry.

title: Cache TTL should come from settings
body: The cache TTL is hard-coded to 300 seconds in `cache.py`. Read it from `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` with 300 as the default.

title: Timezone off by one hour in exported timestamps
body: Exported CSV timestamps are an hour behind during daylight saving time. We format with a fixed UTC-6 offset instead of the America/Chicago zone.

title: Pin numpy below 2.0 until we test it
body: numpy 2.0 changed several APIs we use. Until we've tested it, pin `numpy<2` in requirements.txt so new installs don't break.
